display.purpose: Masthead wordmark only (Archivo 700 italic, 30px, -0.015em; 24px under 720px). The -go suffix is gold.

body.purpose: Readout rows, fleet foot, feed notes — JetBrains Mono 400 at 13px/1.45.

data-value.purpose: The fold-cell's current in-flight count: 30px 500 tabular, lit warm gray; 26px in the fleet strip.

shadows.name: cell-rest
shadows.purpose: The crease score under each cell's 1px lit top border — the only shadow at rest, a 1px score, not a blur.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover: the crease rises (translateY(-3px)) with a deep drop and a gold lit top edge.

shadows.name: opened-fold
shadows.purpose: Opened fold: 1px gold ring + 48px warm gold halo + drop — the selection glow.

shadows.name: saturated
shadows.purpose: Saturated/429-at-cell: the cell inverts to red-on-ground with a faint red halo. Note: a 429 on the TAPE is not this — it is valley blue (capacity rejection = policy working).

shadows.name: packet-btn-hover
shadows.purpose: The gold-foil deploy control's hover glow.

shadows.name: health-live
shadows.purpose: The live feed dot in the masthead (8px, live gold only; degraded has none, offline is red at 0.7).

motion.name: ease-fold
motion.purpose: The fold easing for every cell transition (--ease-fold): fast start, long settling tail.

motion.name: fold-cascade-step
motion.purpose: Per-cell delay in the diagonal deploy cascade (--fold-step); each cell's --fold-delay is order*55ms, so the unfold travels along the tessellation diagonal.

motion.name: fold-in
motion.purpose: One cell's unfold: scaleY(0.14) skewY(2deg) opacity 0 → none, over 0.6s with ease-fold, animation-fill backwards.

motion.name: undulate
motion.purpose: The deployed sheet breathes: cell faces translate up 2px on a 6.5s loop, offset per-cell by calc(var(--fold-delay) * -16) so the wave rides the diagonal. Only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: hover-sweep
motion.purpose: The 2px gold lit-edge sweep across the fold on hover: background-position -60% → 160% over 0.8s (opacity 0.3s).

motion.name: cell-lift
motion.purpose: Hover lift (transform/box-shadow) and background change timing.

motion.name: detail-fade
motion.purpose: The hover detail readout row fades in with a 2px rise.

motion.name: trace-scroll
motion.purpose: Not CSS: the scope's window scrolls at frame rate on a virtual clock anchored to the NEWEST server sample (data arrives on 500ms ticks); the y-scale eases at 0.15 lerp/frame and is scoped to the visible window. Window span is selectable (30s/60s/5m) over a 5-minute history buffer; the line is one uniform color across the whole window. Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the rAF loop is off and the trace redraws on data ticks only.

breakpoints.name: compact
breakpoints.purpose: The single responsive breakpoint: masthead stacks, fleet strip goes single-column, the opened fold's readout drops under the trace, and (in JS) the sheet auto-folds to the packet row.

components.name: Packet Control (deploy/fold)
components.description: The signature interaction: one gold-foil button that folds or deploys the entire tessellation in a stepped diagonal cascade; aria-pressed reflects state.
components.css: .ds-packet-btn { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #c9a24b; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(201,162,75,0.16), rgba(201,162,75,0.04)); border: 1px solid rgba(201,162,75,0.55); border-top-color: rgba(228,194,100,0.9); padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s, background 0.25s; } .ds-packet-btn:hover { color: #e4c264; box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(201,162,75,0.28), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(228,194,100,0.4); } .ds-packet-btn:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #e4c264; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Fold Cell (deployed)
components.description: One backend, one fold: crease ID + tier chip, big tabular value, a live gold trace on the crease grid, and a hover-only detail row. Hover lifts the crease and sweeps a gold lit-edge.
components.html: vllm-king-0T0·KING7/16
components.css: .ds-fold-cell { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #0e0e10; min-height: 168px; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(232,230,224,0.1); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(232,230,224,0.05); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.25,1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.25,1), background 0.3s; } .ds-fold-cell:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); background: #141416; box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,0.55), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(228,194,100,0.55); } .ds-fold-cell::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #e4c264, transparent); background-size: 50% 100%; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-position: -60% 0; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.3s, background-position 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.25,1); } .ds-fold-cell:hover::before { opacity: 1; background-position: 160% 0; } .ds-cell-val { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 500; color: #e8e6e0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-cell-val .ds-max { font-size: 13px; color: #8c867c; }

components.name: Opened Fold (expanded cell)
components.description: A clicked fold opens in place: spans the row (308px), gold ring + halo, full-height trace with a signal switcher (router signals, engine signals when the backend's /metrics feed is live, and a 30s/60s/5m window selector), ttft overlay, legend, and a 272px readout column whose values ellipsize inside the column.

components.css: .ds-opened-fold { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 272px; gap: 18px; background: #141416; min-height: 308px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(228,194,100,0.4), 0 0 48px rgba(201,162,75,0.16), 0 14px 44px rgba(0,0,0,0.55); border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 14px 8px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-open-trace-wrap { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0; } .ds-switcher-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 6px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-switcher { display: flex; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-switcher button { font-family: inherit; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8c867c; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(166,166,160,0.25); border-radius: 0; padding: 4px 9px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switcher button.on { color: #e4c264; border-color: rgba(201,162,75,0.7); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(228,194,100,0.35); } .ds-win-sep { width: 1px; align-self: stretch; margin: 2px 4px; background: rgba(166,166,160,0.25); } .ds-esc { margin-left: auto; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a6a29a; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(166,166,160,0.18); padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 0; } .ds-readout { min-width: 0; } .ds-readout .ds-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 5px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(166,166,160,0.12); font-size: 11px; min-width: 0; } .ds-readout .ds-k { color: #8c867c; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; flex: none; } .ds-readout .ds-v { color: #edebe4; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; text-align: right; }

components.name: Fleet Strip Cell
components.description: One of four wide aggregate cells (req/s · measured, ttft, tok/s · new-prefill est, decode tok/s · real) on the same skewed grid: uppercase label, 26px tabular value, live trace below. The est (gold) and real (steel-blue) pairing is the honest data boundary: body-based prefill estimate beside the engine's measured throughput.
components.html: decode tok/s · real320
components.css: .ds-fleet-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 1px; background: #161513; border: 1px solid rgba(166,166,160,0.3); transform: skewX(-6deg); transform-origin: 50% 0; margin-top: 16px; } .ds-fleet-cell { background: #0e0e10; min-height: 118px; padding: 10px 16px 8px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-fleet-label { font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8c867c; } .ds-est { color: #c9a24b; } .ds-real { color: #cfe0ef; } .ds-fleet-value { font-size: 26px; line-height: 1; color: #e8e6e0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-fleet-trace { flex: 1; min-height: 0; position: relative; background: linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 30%, rgba(143,169,192,0.09) 30.25%, transparent 30.5%), repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 43px, rgba(166,166,160,0.12) 43px 44px); }

narrative.overview:
The fleet is a sheet. Every backend is a fold-cell in one tessellated Miura grid, and the grid undulates with live load — what an operator sees at a glance is a single continuous surface, the whole fleet's requests, latency, and GPU pressure as one field of linked creases, not a scatter of unrelated cards. The world is dark-ink: a matte near-black sheet (#0a0a0b) scored with warm-gray mountain creases and steel-blue valley creases, carrying a single gold-foil live signal. The first thing the eye lands on is a live gold line moving on the sheet.

This is an operate-in-situ surface: an ML-infrastructure operator checks it while traffic is live, at arm's length, in a dark room. Density is high but disciplined — the data is the decoration. Every number is the router's actual in-flight state (never a stale or derived approximation), and the honesty boundary is visual: token figures come in two labeled kinds — estimated prefill (gold est, request-body based) and the engine's own measured throughput (steel-blue real, scraped from each backend's /metrics). The committed refusals, carried from the world contract: a row of equal dashboard cards, and the dark "near-black + one neon accent + glowing edges" ops board — here gold is a signal line, not a glow, and the sheet is one field, not a card grid.
keyCharacteristics: One tessellated field of sharp-cornered parallelogram fold-cells under a shared isometric skew (-6deg)
Gold-foil (#c9a24b) as the only hot color: the live trace, the active state, nothing decorative
Uniform-color trace lines across the full visible window (30s/60s/5m over 5 minutes of history) — no afterglow fade; the line stays the same color end to end
Depth by fold geometry, not shadows: recessed 1px seams, 1px crease-scored lit edges, a ~3% diagonal sheen
Archivo 700 italic for the masthead; JetBrains Mono for every number, ID, label, and line of the tape
Two-labeled token truth: est (body-based prefill estimate, gold) beside real (engine-measured prefill/decode tok/s, steel-blue, from the backend's /metrics)
One pull deploys the whole field: the [DEPLOY]/[FOLD] packet control cascades every cell in a stepped diagonal (55ms per cell)
The same sheet folds to a thin packet row — the mobile/compact mode is the fold, not a separate layout

rules.name: The One Hot Color Rule
rules.body: Gold is the live signal and nothing else. Its rarity — thin lines, small lit edges, one button — is the point. A screen with a gold surface, a gold block, or gold used for emphasis of a non-signal value has left the world.

rules.name: The Red Reservation Rule
rules.body: Red appears only on 5xx / saturated / offline — the failure conditions — plus the STALE feed-loss banner. A 429 on the tape is NOT red: it is valley blue (a capacity rejection with Retry-After is the policy working as designed). If a red pixel isn't a failure condition, delete it.

rules.name: The Est Label Rule
rules.body: Token figures are either estimated new-prefill tokens (gold est, 9px, 0.1em) or the engine's measured throughput (steel-blue real). Anywhere a token number appears, one of the two labels sits beside it: fleet strip, readout rows, tape column. A token figure without est or real is a lie about the data.

rules.name: The Uniform Line Rule
rules.body: A trace line is one color across its entire visible window — gold (#c9a24b, α 0.9, 1.5px) or valley steel (#8fa9c0, α 0.45 for overlays). No afterglow fade, no brightness-as-age encoding: the operator must be able to follow a signal's shape across the full 5-minute history without the line's color changing under them. Only the newest sample wears the lit head dot.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every live number uses tabular numerals. A ticking value that shifts horizontal weight has broken the sheet's calm.

rules.name: The Fold-Is-Depth Rule
rules.body: If a surface isn't reacting to hover, selection, or failure, it carries no shadow and no glow. Ambient depth is geometry — seams, crease scores, the sheen — not blur. Glassmorphism, heavy drop shadows, and decorative glows are outside this world.

rules.name: The Value-Wins Rule
rules.body: A fold effect that makes a value hard to read loses to the value. The skew must never put a number behind another number; the cascade must not delay reading a value; text inside the skew is always counter-skewed; long values ellipsize inside their column instead of running off the fold.

dos: Do use gold (#c9a24b / #e4c264) only for live signals and active states: the trace line and its lit head, hover/selection edges, the packet control, focus outlines, and the est label.
Do use steel-blue (#8fa9c0 / #cfe0ef) for the secondary signal family: the ttft overlay, limit lines, and REAL engine-measured figures (decode tok/s cell, engine signals).
Do counter-skew (.unskew) every text element inside a skewed container, so numbers stay horizontal, crisp, and selectable.
Do label every token figure: gold est for body-based prefill estimates, steel-blue real for engine-measured throughput — and show both in the fleet strip so the boundary is visible.
Do use tabular numerals on every value that ticks.
Do keep the sr-only flat table next to the tessellation — including the engine columns — so the sheet always has its non-skewed accessible twin.
Do draw traces as a scrolling scope: server timestamps, eased window-scoped y-scale, one uniform color across the window, lit head dot, 30s/60s/5m window over a 5-minute buffer.
Do render missing engine data as an explicit off/err state (one line in the readout: endpoint absent or unreachable) — never as zero and never as a guess.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: reduce by disabling the deploy cascade, the undulation, the hover sweep, and the rAF scroll — the trace then redraws on ticks only.
donts: Don't use gold for decoration, emphasis, or any surface — one hot color, live signal only.
Don't use red (#d46a5e) for anything except 5xx / saturated / offline state and the STALE banner; a 429 stays valley blue on the tape.
Don't round a corner. Zero radius is the fold; the parallelogram comes from skew, not border-radius.
Don't fade a trace line's color by age — the line is one color from the oldest visible sample to the head.
Don't let the skew obscure a value — no number behind another number; if a fold effect delays reading a value, the value wins.
Don't add ambient shadows, glassmorphism, or glows at rest; shadow/glow is a state response (hover lift, opened-fold ring, saturated inversion) in the exact documented values.
Don't present the body-based token estimate as measured, and don't present the engine's measured throughput as an estimate — each carries its label.
Don't run a per-cell 60fps loop — one rAF-driven scope per trace instance, redrawn on data ticks otherwise.
Don't build the compact/mobile view as a separate layout — it is the folded sheet (packet row), driven by the same deploy state.
